entities.summary: Scott Thomas Armstrong Jr. was an American professional basketball player. He played in the National Basketball League for the Fort Wayne General Electrics, Oshkosh All-Stars, and Indianapolis Kautskys. Armstrong was an NBL all-star during his lone season on Oshkosh (1938–39). While living in Indianapolis, Indiana and playing for the Kautskys, he also served as an assistant coach for Butler University's men's basketball team, his alma mater where he had previously played. Armstrong's post-basketball life included serving in the United States Navy and becoming a principal of a junior high school.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As an NBL all-star and assistant coach for Butler University's men's basketball team, Scott Armstrong had a notable impact on local sports in Indiana during his playing career. His post-basketball life as a principal of a junior high school further solidified his significance in the regional educational landscape.
